judgments.reason: The span 'Progressive weakness on the right side of body for 5 days' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports the right-sided lateralization of the hemiplegic syndrome.

The span 'Complete hemiplegia' appears literally in the vignette under examination findings and clinically supports the hemiplegic component of the diagnosis, though it does not specify laterality on its own; in context with other right-sided findings it is consistent with right-sided acute hemiplegic syndrome.

The span 'Upper motor neuron type right-sided seventh cranial-nerve palsy' appears literally in the vignette and explicitly supports right-sided localization, consistent with right-sided acute hemiplegic syndrome.
